prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-body transparent character sprite for an existing local animated wardrobe app.
Primary request: Create a polished independent full-body illustration of the adult fictional woman shown in the two supplied reference images. Image 1 is the main reference for facial design, hair, colors, accessories and tailoring. Image 2 is the reference for the complete dress, six buttons, silhouette and shoes. The reference images are visual design references only.
Subject: A clearly adult fictional East Asian woman, age 29, with a mature refined oval face, cool teal-blue almond eyes, long lashes, elegantly arched dark eyebrows, small nose, glossy rose lips, and a composed slightly aloof expression with a subtle warm smile. Long sleek side-parted jet-black hair with cool blue highlights, reaching the waist. Preserve the distinctive reference character design.
Outfit: Fully opaque dusty rose pink tailored wrap-lapel blazer dress with three-quarter sleeves, fitted waist, six black round jewel buttons arranged in two columns of three, and a tasteful above-knee straight skirt. Tailored fashion fit and natural mature proportions. A delicate gold chain necklace, small pearl drop earrings, a white rectangular wristwatch, pale lavender nail polish and ivory pointed-toe high-heel pumps.
Composition/framing: One woman only, upright neutral standing pose, directly facing camera, shoulders level, arms relaxed slightly apart from the body with both hands and fingers fully visible. Feet modestly apart, both shoes and heels fully inside the frame. Full body from hair top to shoe soles on a 1024 x 1536 portrait canvas, with clear margins. Eye line around the upper tenth of the image. No phone or hand-held props.
Style/medium: Premium detailed Korean webtoon fashion character illustration, clean delicate linework, soft dimensional semi-realistic shading, crisp facial features, glossy black hair, refined fabric and jewelry. Match the identity and pink outfit of the supplied references while making a clean front-view model.
Lighting: Soft balanced studio lighting on the figure only.
Scene/backdrop: Truly transparent RGBA background, alpha zero outside the figure.
Constraints: Fully dressed fashion portrait; no scene, no floor or cast shadow, no halo, no text, captions, bubbles, logos or watermarks, no other people, no cropped head or shoes, no extra limbs. Keep all clothing opaque.
